structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Broader spacecraft, communications and ground capabilities increase mission-scope capture, but evidence does not establish exclusive control.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Multi-domain government/commercial exposure broadens demand surfaces while milestone timing, acquired-program integration and cash conversion remain material dependencies.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Integrated mission scope can reduce single-product dependence, but competing prime contractors and alternative suppliers remain credible substitutes.

discovery-weak-signals.name: space infrastructure platform breadth
discovery-weak-signals.basis: backlog growth plus ground-network expansion broadens the company beyond lunar delivery into multi-domain space infrastructure

adversarial-red-team.name: financialOperatingMomentum
adversarial-red-team.basis: Revenue/backlog scale is real, but first-half operating cash flow was negative $111.878M.

adversarial-red-team.name: governancePower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Reviewed Beta lineage does not establish a present governance defect; no bearish inference is manufactured.

adversarial-red-team.name: pricingPower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Program-level margin/pricing evidence is insufficient for a defensible conclusion.

expectations-execution.name: commercial execution and bookings
expectations-execution.basis: reported revenue acceleration and award volume indicate meaningful conversion from strategy into contracted work

thesisQuality.basis: Large backlog, acquired platform breadth and demonstrated spacecraft delivery support durable demand, but value capture is not yet proven through normalized margins/cash conversion.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue and bookings accelerated and cash balance is substantial, offset by negative first-half operating cash flow, working-capital intensity and acquisition execution burden.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current market observation near 6.5x sales while loss-making and with rapid share-count growth makes valuation demanding relative to still-unproven cash economics.

catalystScore.basis: Q3 awards, a >$600M anticipated communications program and successful SXM-11 handover provide multiple material identifiable catalysts, with program conversion uncertainty preventing exceptional treatment.

governancePower.basis: Proxy supports formal board/committee and conflicts oversight, but available lineage does not demonstrate exceptional capital-allocation outcomes through the acquisition-led scaling phase.

alignment2036.basis: Spacecraft, communications, lunar and ground-network capabilities serve durable civil and national-security infrastructure needs across multiple long-duration space markets.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Lunar delivery, spacecraft manufacturing, communications and ground services create several demand channels reusing integrated mission capabilities, though acquired concentration remains material.

bottleneckControl.basis: Integrated spacecraft/communications/ground scope participates in constrained mission infrastructure, but evidence does not establish exclusive control or absence of practical prime-contractor substitutes.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Government, commercial, lunar and communications demand broaden scenarios, but customer concentration, milestone timing and integration dependence remain important.

substitutionResilience.basis: Integrated mission breadth and delivered spacecraft provide moderate replacement barriers, while credible competing primes and alternative suppliers remain.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Inventory and supplier advances show active provisioning, but the evidence does not establish tested multi-source redundancy and instead reveals meaningful working-capital exposure.

pricingPower.basis: Large awards demonstrate demand but program-level margin/pass-through evidence is undisclosed, so durable pricing power cannot be credited above a weak-to-mixed assessment.

riskEvidence.basis: Material risks include negative cash conversion, acquisition integration, customer concentration, milestone-driven revenue and rapid dilution/share-count growth.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Core financial, governance and operating claims are supported by direct SEC/issuer sources plus a distinct current market source; confidence is reduced for undisclosed normalized margins, pricing and cancellation terms.

scoreRecord.thesis: Intuitive Machines is becoming a broader civil/national-security space-infrastructure platform with substantial contracted demand and multiple execution catalysts, but acquisition-led scale must prove margin and cash conversion at a valuation that already discounts meaningful growth.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Backlog and acquired scale fail to convert into durable margins/free cash flow while concentration, integration and dilution absorb shareholder value.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Conversion of 2026 awards and the multi-satellite communications program into recognized revenue, delivery milestones and improved cash economics.
